label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Optimize Your Email Preheader
body: This short preview text appears right after your subject line, giving subscribers another reason to open your email.
caption:
The preheader text is the short line visible after your subject line. It's valuable space, so don't let it just auto-fill. Use it to add context or a compelling hook. A good preheader boosts open rates by giving another reason to click. Craft yours with purpose! What will your next one say?
